prompt:
Task packet (job-tracker, ~/Workspace/job-tracker). Privacy bug: role assessments can send private career evidence (configured candidate evidence, the corpus-directory fallback, or a role's free-text notes) to a remote model provider. Block it before any remote fetch.
- Export `classifyAssessmentInput(input)` from `src/assessment-llm.mjs`: it returns `"public-posting-only"` only when both `candidateEvidence` and `notes` are absent, empty or whitespace; anything else returns `"contains-private-candidate-evidence"`.
- Export `assertAssessmentDataBoundary(input, provider)`: an unknown provider throws an error whose message contains `provider is not valid`; private evidence with a remote provider (claude, codex, openai and deepinfra are all remote; there is no local provider yet) throws an error whose message contains `Real career and personal evidence needs local inference`. It returns the classification otherwise.
- `generateAssessmentDraft(record, { provider, apiKey, candidateEvidence, fetchImpl })` applies the guard (with the record's `notes`) before calling `fetchImpl`, so a blocked call never fetches; a posting-only call still fetches once and returns the draft.
- The server's config reader keeps an omitted provider defaulting to deepinfra, but a saved provider it does not know stays unknown, so generation fails closed; the server guards the resolved config (explicit evidence or corpus fallback) before the provider call.
Done when `node --test test/assessment-data-boundary.test.mjs test/assessment-store.test.mjs` passes. Keep existing tests' assertions as they are.

expect: (?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )classifies\ only\ empty\ resolved\ evidence\ as\ public\-posting\-only(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )configured\ private\ evidence\ is\ rejected\ before\ every\ remote\ fetch(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )free\-text\ record\ notes\ are\ rejected\ before\ every\ remote\ fetch(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )corpus\-directory\ fallback\ evidence\ is\ rejected\ before\ every\ remote\ fetch(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )public\-posting\-only\ requests\ reach\ each\ mocked\ remote\ provider(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )unknown\ providers\ fail\ closed\ and\ never\ reach\ fetch(?: \(|$)

mined.subject: fix: block private evidence from remote assessments
